description: Use this when the user wants to compare two commission plans or comp plans ("compare these two comp plans", "which plan pays more at 120% of quota"): computes the commission each plan pays at several sales levels, the difference, and where one plan overtakes the other, with tiers, accelerators, quota percentages and caps applied, computed in cents. Does not handle draws, deal lists or taxes, and does not judge which plan is fair. Do not use for a single plan's payout (use calculate_commission).

currency.description: ISO currency code, default USD, e.g. CAD or EUR.

base_salary.description: Base salary for the same period as ote, e.g. 15000.

bonuses.description: One-off bonuses or SPIFFs for the period, outside tiers and the cap, e.g. [{"label":"President's club SPIFF","amount":1000}].

label.description: Bonus or SPIFF name, e.g. "Q3 new-logo SPIFF".

cap_amount.description: Maximum commission on deals for the period, e.g. 25000. SPIFFs and bonuses are outside the cap.

clawback_percent.description: Share of the original commission clawed back, in percent, default 100.

clawback_window_days.description: Days after close in which a refund or cancellation claws back commission, e.g. 90. Leave out to claw back any cancellation.

commission_base.description: What the rate applies to: revenue (deal amount, default) or gross_margin (each deal's margin or margin_percent).

draw_amount.description: Draw against commission paid for the period, e.g. 3000.

draw_type.description: recoverable (default: a shortfall carries forward and is repaid from later commission) or non_recoverable (the shortfall is forgiven, not repaid).

name.description: Plan label, e.g. "AE plan FY26" or "Plan A".

ote.description: On-target earnings for the period, e.g. 30000; use with base_salary to derive target variable pay = OTE - base salary.

quota.description: Quota for the period in currency, e.g. 150000. Used for attainment and quota-percent tiers.

rate.description: Flat commission rate in percent, e.g. 10 for 10%. With tiers that use multipliers this is the base commission rate.

target_variable.description: Target variable (incentive) pay at 100% of quota for the period, e.g. 15000. With quota it sets the base commission rate = target_variable / quota.

tier_method.description: marginal (stepped: each slice of sales at its own tier rate) or retroactive (all sales at the rate of the highest tier reached). Leave out when the plan wording does not say; both results are then shown.

tier_unit.description: Tier limits in currency (amount, default) or in percent of quota attainment (quota_percent, needs quota).

tiers.description: Tiered rates in ascending order. "5% up to 50k then 8% above" = [{"up_to":50000,"rate":5},{"up_to":null,"rate":8}]. Accelerator over quota with tier_unit quota_percent: [{"up_to":100,"rate":10},{"up_to":null,"rate":15}].

multiplier.description: Instead of a rate: a multiple of the base commission rate, e.g. 1.5 for an accelerator above quota or 0.5 for a decelerator below 50% of quota.

rate.description: Commission rate for this tier in percent, e.g. 8 for 8%.

up_to.description: Upper limit of this tier, inclusive, in currency (e.g. 50000) or in percent of quota when tier_unit is quota_percent (e.g. 100). Leave null on the last, open-ended tier.

unknown_status_as_won.description: Count deals whose status is not recognised (e.g. "Signed - pending") as closed-won. Default false: they are listed as not counted.
